facts.business: Flexituff Ventures International Limited manufactures and exports Flexible Intermediate Bulk Containers (FIBCs) and non-woven retail products such as floor covering carpets.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: close to 4 Million bags per year

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Going concern uncertainty due to net loss of Rs. 1,348.79 million, current liabilities exceeding current assets by Rs. 3,223.39 million, erosion of net worth, outstanding statutory compliances, unpaid employee payables, defaults on borrowings, inability to perform audit procedures due to management deadlock and lack of cooperation, unresolved debt defaults with banks under SARFAESI Act (total debt Rs. 2,597.13 million), impairment indicators for loans to subsidiaries (Rs. 255.83 million) not recognized, unpaid statutory employee liabilities (PF, ESIC, PT, Gratuity), no internal audit conducted (non-compliance with Section 138), non-compliance with Companies Act 2013 and SEBI Listing Regulations.

key_risks: Cyclical demand and pricing in principal markets
Change in government regulations and tax regime
Politico-economic conditions in India and countries of operation
Substantial receivables stuck with government departments
Working capital shortage leading to procurement at elevated prices
Disruption in operations due to non-availability of critical raw materials
Labour strikes due to non-payment of wages
Defaults on borrowings and SARFAESI notices from lenders
Erosion of net worth and going concern uncertainty
Non-compliance with statutory payments and listing fees
Inability to perform audit procedures due to management deadlock
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances given to subsidiaries amounting to Rs. 255.83 million (including interest) as at 31 March 2026; subsidiaries facing severe operational and financial difficulties; management considers balance fully recoverable but auditor unable to verify impairment.
